findings: Earlier evidence already established that the single 32s mixed-load close sample cannot establish W2 write-heavy close cost.
The 117s W2 observation is high-side contaminated, so it also cannot establish a representative W2 reserve.
Consequently pooled close-reserve estimation is currently underidentified by profile; final UNIVERSAL_CAP versus PROFILE_AWARE_CAP remains open.
The current W3 probe should prioritize a directly timestamped uncontaminated close path at target to add a profile-relevant sample if the invocation survives to target.
